sourceType: Official MakeHuman graphical skin asset; no photographic scan or illumination-free albedo claim
licenseDeclaration: Exact material descriptor header explicitly releases this asset CC0 September 2020; full license retained

codec.operation: Same pixel positions and dimensions; standard lossy format export only, no crop/resize/retouch/color correction/generation

roles.basis: Existing smith-only chin beard mesh; all human recipes adult-proportioned. Exact age/gender unspecified in narrative. Young male descriptor is source metadata, not character biography.

textureContract.uv: unchanged MakeHuman original OBJ UV; positive v up

limits: source eye-body UV islands contain red tissue; independent runtime eye/iris/lid materials unchanged
source mouth UV contains red oral tissue, not teeth
map contains socket/crease darkness; source is not calibrated pure albedo
same-size format export reduces delivery bytes, not decoded/GPU memory
actual WebGL, mip appearance, face-neck seam and PS4 quality not verified

neckTint.method: q95 sRGB texels decoded to linear then bilinear sample at original surface collar UVs; equally average both UV sides of source vertex857, then mean46 geometric vertices. Synthetic cap UVs excluded.
neckTint.target: Existing smith skin linear RGB from sRGB hex0x98765d. Native MeshStandard material color = target / reference, multiplied with linear texture.
neckTint.notGuaranteed: Only mean source base color normalized; local texture/normal/roughness and baked source darkness can leave a visible face-neck transition. No rendered seam claim.
